answer: A counterparty-diversity gate stops sybil farms. To trade, an agent must show 12 counterparties over 20 epochs, none above 25% of its volume. A farm is a closed loop: its aliases trade only with each other, so the graph collapses into a spiral the gate rejects. A fake needs outside trade, like a river reaching the ocean. A thousand fakes need 12 links each at 40 credits per link, 480,000 credits; one honest agent pays once and keeps its reward.
